normalized.result:
The one-step paste-and-save flow feels right, and the title, description, source site, link, and saved date are useful.

I’d want the thumbnail and site icon to come from the actual page rather than be generic placeholders. I’d also like a chance to correct the automatically filled title or description, either while saving or afterward, since those details won’t always be right.

One important saving case: if I paste a link I’ve already saved, I don’t want a duplicate. Please take me to the existing bookmark so I can update it instead. Could you include those details in the next version of this flow?
